description: A well defined extra-axial mass arising from the intercanalicular portion of the right IAM smoothly fungating into the right CPA. The lesion shows hypointense T1 signal and isointense T2 signal. Avid enhancement followed contrast administration, with areas of internal non-enhancing cystic changes.
